# FQHESphereFuseStates

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereFuseStates`

```text
FQHESphereFuseStates, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereFuseStates [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -i, --input-states : file that describes states to fuse
    --padding : number of empty one-body states to insert between two fused Hilbert spaces (default value = 0)
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state of the output state
    --symmetrized-basis : use Lz <-> -Lz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-lz=0)
    --huge-basis : use huge Hilbert space support
    --memory : maximum memory (in MBytes) that can allocated for precalculations when using huge mode (default value = 100)
    --rational : use rational numbers instead of double precision floating point numbers
    --add : add the different vector instead of merging them
    --multiple-add : use multiple description files, each of then in add mode, merging results of each description file
    --multiple-fuse : file describing multiple state fusion

output options:
    -o, --output-file : name of the fused vector that will be generated
    -t, --txt-output : output the vector into a text file

precalculation options:
    --load-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the indicated file (only available for the Haldane basis)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
